scope.components: Hand-curated backend UI components from the styleguide and the backend Sass sources, each with every Sass file it spans and the TYPO3 majors it was verified on. A subset: not every CSS class in the core is described here. `bin/verify-catalog` with no argument re-derives those majors from one checkout per covered version.
scope.systemExtensions: Every system extension of every covered TYPO3 line, read off one checkout per version: the extension key, the Composer package name to require it by, what it is for, and the majors that ship it. Complete rather than curated — `bin/verify-catalog` with no argument re-derives it, so a release that adds or drops one is reported.
